notes.title: Arran: The Book of Heroes Live!
Arran: The Book of Heroes Live!
The Next Fest Demo is Here!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41049831/e1ce13442a2fbbc4eb4a75b2955028cb1f44bf7c.png[/img]
[b]Good news everyone![/b]

We're super happy to announce our NextFest Demo is up and running! ːsteamhappyː

It now has 2 available Missions to play,
The main 5 Heroes to choose from,
A great variety of Items to be looted and
Tons of enemies and secrets!

We’ve also fixed lots of bugs and other minor issues.

Also, our newly [url=https://discord.gg/4DmjWETHC4]Discord[/url] channel is now public.

Please share your feedback as it is always welcomed.

[b]Expect more juicy news in the upcoming days![/b]

notes.title: Arran: The Book of Heroes Demo Update - Version 0.5.1
notes.content:
Patch Notes v0.5.1

Bugfixes
Fixed Minimap visual glitches.
Fixed collision issues at some map areas.
Fixed game flow getting stuck at The Den area.
Improved Enemy collisions.

Known Issues
UI Minimap marker getting stuck occasionally during multiplayer sessions.

notes.title: Update 0.3.5 available now!
notes.content:
Hi Everyone!

We`ve just released a small update of Arran Demo, with some fixes and balance:

[list]
[*] Fixed Bug where difficulty got unbalanced when players randomly connected and disconnected from the session.
[*] Fixed maximum players setup in Create Game Screen.
[*] Added two more Respawning Points to decrease time between players resurrection.
[*] Overall difficulty review.
[*] General performance tweaks and optimization.
[/list]
